title: Mixed Event — Mermaid Admiration — Episode7 A World Unbeknownst to Us

meta.Episode: Episode7 — A World Unbeknownst to Us
meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime has begun working as ambassadors for Phoenix Wonderland. Their first visit will be to an outdoor stage on a beach. Hearing this, Nene remembers the performance of "The Little Mermaid" that she saw when she was little...

rows.Line: Beach

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, um... H-How did you like our show?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
It absolutely blew me away!
Thank you for inviting me to see it, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: From start to finish, each scene was full of excitement, but... My favorite part had to be when you sang for us, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: The way you sang really sent me back in time to when I was much younger.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: When you were younger?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Yes... I was exposed to theatre for the very first time in high school and never felt the sort of exhilaration that shows can give you until then.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I moved to Tokyo right after I graduated to pursue a career in acting...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: But it took me a very long time to make that decision. I was so scared of diving into a world that was completely unknown to me.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
But as scared as I was...
I took the leap, and you reminded me of how I was able to muster up the courage to do so, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I didn't expect to hear the word scared come out of your mouth...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're a globetrotting celebrity, so I was under the impression that you were fearless.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm really not as strong as you say I am. I get nervous before the curtains go up just like anybody else.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I think it just has to do with how my desire to perform in shows all around the world usually wins in the end...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Would you mind telling me more about that...?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I really want to know more about what it's been like for you doing shows all over the world...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, but... I know you're a very busy person, so I won't keep you if you don't have time to...!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Haha! I'd be more than happy to tell you!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: After The Little Mermaid became a success, I stayed in Japan and kept honing my craft.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: But as time went on, my desire to be a part of bigger and better things led me to move to the United States...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: That was also a very rough time for me. Not a day went by when I didn't feel discouraged in some way...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I've seen some videos of your U.S. performances.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Based on what I saw, it seemed like nothing was bothering you at all. You looked confident...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Hehe. I may've looked that way, but I struggled with my English. Even though I studied as hard as I could, the language barrier between me and my colleagues led to some trouble.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I couldn't get any of my points across to them. But at the same time, I didn't want to give up after coming so far...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I practiced singing and dancing harder than anyone else, and even worked on my improvisation skills...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I ran headfirst into that language barrier and felt the culture shock of being in a completely new world...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: But success never felt sweeter when I did figure things out in the end...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Hehe...
Her eyes are sparkling.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That must've been a really incredible show...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: And then...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really?! Theatre's doing that well abroad...?!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: To be fair, these other countries have so many theaters to start, as well as so many actors with an unimaginably wide range of personalities.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: When I went to India to study traditional dances there, I thought my body was going to give out because of how hard I had to work.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: But it felt so great when I did learn to do it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She's like one of those globetrotting actresses you see in the movies...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It must be scary to travel to all these different places to do shows...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But really exciting at the same time...
Singing and dancing while the whole world watches...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Her life sounds like so much fun. Maybe someday, I'll...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (No, we'll...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Looking back, I've been able to visit so many different places...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: But I wouldn't have been able to do that without the help of all those who were there to support me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I'm here today because of my friends.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Your friends?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Yes.
I actually started out in a very small troupe.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
It didn't even have ten people.
But they were kind enough to take in a novice like me.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Most others laughed at me when I told them about how I wanted to do shows around the world, but this troupe didn't.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They seem like really nice people...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: They were.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Which is why leaving them was so hard...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Can I ask what happened to that troupe...?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: They're still around. But some left for greener pastures like I did, and the next generation seems to be running the show now.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Everybody's chasing after their own dreams and doing what they can to make them come true. It's nice but also makes me sad sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I really loved being in shows with them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Right...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If I want to perform in shows while traveling around the world, that means...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We won't be together...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: But I don't regret my decision.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I've been able to achieve my dreams and learn to love doing shows because they were there to support me...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Relationships may come and go, but wonderful shows are born in the process...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Saying goodbye is a very sad thing, but that's not the whole story. There's just as much joy hiding behind that sadness.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: So please, Nene, keep trying your best...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I will...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you very much for coming today. I'll be looking forward to your show.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: You're welcome, and thank you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Travel around the world and make people smile by putting on shows...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That kind of life would be amazing.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But that means someday, I have to...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I can't see myself doing that...
<Is everything okay, Nene...?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Who's there...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <It's me...>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Luka, it's you...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That reminds me... I completely forgot about promising to show you the beach. I'm so sorry...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Hehe. Don't mind me.
I've actually been taking peeks here and there in secret♪>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You have? Who knows what'll happen if you get caught.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But... There aren't that many people around right now, so why don't we take a quick stroll before meeting back up with the others?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <You'd do that? Thank you, Nene!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Alright, let's go.
